text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I come to observe, they never cut corners,
striving every single day to shine with all their might."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'm so truly glad... that I was able to meet such wonderful people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello watched <chrname>'s
training with a gentle smile on her face.
